steps.title: Book Your Driver in 3 Simple Steps
steps.subtitle: Get a verified professional driver at your doorstep in minutes

items.title: Select Location & Category
items.description: Enter your pickup address and choose your trip category (Short-Term, Outstation, or Long-Term Hire).

items.title: Pick Time & Preferences
items.description: Choose your start date/time, vehicle transmission (Manual/Automatic), and trip options.

items.title: Instant Driver Allocation
items.description: A verified professional driver is assigned with real-time tracking straight to your location.

guarantees.title: Zero Surge Guarantee
guarantees.description: Rain, festival, or peak rush hour — our hourly rates remain fixed without price spikes.

guarantees.title: 100% Background Verified
guarantees.description: Every driver undergoes driving skill assessment, police verification, and document validation.

guarantees.title: 24/7 Live Safety Desk
guarantees.description: Our safety desk monitors every ride with real-time telemetry and emergency SOS assistance.

guarantees.title: Flexible Cancellation
guarantees.description: Cancel or reschedule your driver booking without hassle before trip dispatch.
